source.scope: Current working-tree Android color schemes and launcher/splash source resources.

method.rounding: Ratios displayed to six decimals; threshold flags evaluated before rounding.
method.pair_selection: Semantic content/container pairs; main text, secondary text and primary action color on every neutral surface/background; secondary text on tonal panels; outline on every neutral surface/background. Outline/surface and outline/background are explicit rows.

limitations: These are color-role calculations from source, not a claim of global WCAG conformity or a rendered accessibility audit.
Candidate pair inclusion does not establish that every combination is rendered by a current screen.
Disabled alpha, state overlays, elevation tint, compositing, antialiasing, images and system-rendered components are not evaluated.
Font size, weight, focus visibility, keyboard behavior and touch target dimensions are outside this artifact.
outlineVariant is a decorative separator role and is excluded from input-outline threshold findings.
Device screenshots and parent-led runtime tests are separate evidence and are not claimed by this calculation.
HEAD identity comparisons normalize CRLF/LF; raw source hashes are separately identified.
